name: Ngoc Son Temple
kicker: The temple on the island in Hoan Kiem
summary: Cross the The Huc bridge to the temple on the island in Hoan Kiem. The lake path is free. The temple is not. The management board and Vietnam Tourism both charge an adult 50,000 VND, and they do not print the same hours. Read both clocks before you queue.
getThere: Cross the The Huc bridge from the lake path
heroCaption: The The Huc bridge to Ngoc Son Temple

notice.title: Two hour tables for the same ticket
notice.body: Adult 50,000 VND on both sources. The management board prints Monday to Thursday until 19:00, and Friday to Sunday until 22:00. Vietnam Tourism prints weekdays until 18:00, and the weekend until 22:00.

body: The Huc bridge is the red bridge to the island. The management board says Nguyen Van Sieu renovated the temple in 1864, that the bridge name means where the morning sun rests, and that the temple worships Tran Hung Dao and Van Xuong. The lake path around the island is a different visit, and Vietnam Tourism says that path is free.

From 1 January 2024 the management board charges an adult 50,000 VND, half price 25,000 VND, and nothing for visitors under 16. Its hours are Monday to Thursday 7:00 to 19:00, and Friday to Sunday and holidays 7:00 to 22:00. Vietnam Tourism prints the same 50,000 VND, with Monday to Friday 7:00 to 18:00 and Saturday to Sunday 7:00 to 22:00. The minutes on the island are check on arrival.

figures.caption: Incense at the temple court, under the tiled roof
figures.alt: A visitor at the incense burner in Ngoc Son Temple

gettingThere: Walk the Hoan Kiem path and cross the The Huc bridge. The bridge is the entrance to the ticketed temple. The minutes from a named hotel are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the lake path
legs.body: Walk to the The Huc bridge. The path is free. The temple ticket starts at the island.

hours: Management board: Monday–Thursday 7:00–19:00; Friday–Sunday and holidays 7:00–22:00. Vietnam Tourism: Monday–Friday 7:00–18:00; Saturday–Sunday 7:00–22:00.
admissionNote: Adult 50,000 VND on both sources. The management board, from 1 January 2024, also prints half price 25,000 VND and free under 16.
